title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.01080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy,

translated_title: 通过价值引导的信息性搜索改进数学推理
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升了大型语言模型的数学推理能力。近期研究将搜索引入RLVR的rollout过程中以增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身并不能保证搜索产生的rollout策略优于当前策略。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了APIVIS，这是一个将有限预算的Gumbel搜索适配到分块级数学推理的训练时框架。APIVIS在每个rollout组中结合直接生成的响应与搜索得到的响应，使搜索所发现的改进能够产生信息丰富的相对奖励。此外，它还对搜索改进的token应用选择性监督，从而在统一的组奖励使GRPO失效时仍能保留学习信号。我们证明，精确的价值引导选择能够提高每个搜索状态下的期望验证器奖励，并且这一保证可以扩展至完整的rollout策略。
tldr: 提出APIVIS训练框架，将有限预算的价值引导Gumbel搜索与选择性监督相结合引入RLVR，使搜索发现的改进能够产生有效的奖励信号，从而提升大语言模型的数学推理能力。
